description: This Python file defines application configuration management for 'notes_backend'. It includes a typed configuration class (AppConfig) and a function (get_config) that reads environment variables, providing default values for database path and CORS origins.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: A frozen dataclass encapsulating configuration parameters such as database path and CORS allowed origins.

methods.name: AppConfig get_config()
methods.description: Reads environment variables to construct and return an AppConfig instance with configuration settings, using defaults if environment variables are not set.
